scope: BlockEdit external-source viewport picker, shared base-point getter and idle double-click opening
native_engine: Rhino 8.32.26160.13001 x86-64 through ARM64 Wine/FEX on private Xvfb
source_picker: Eligible original IDs are cached at opening. The viewport source predicate bypasses temporary editor protection only for source capture, while original hidden/locked permissions remain authoritative. Picks stay in a separate set and highlight list; they never enter editable selection or unlock the model. Enter copies, Escape cancels the getter; selection commands and region paths use the same source set.
point_getter: Bare SetBasePoint enters the established drafting pipeline for snapping, point filters, units and CPlane coordinates. Direct command coordinates retain their documented world-space meaning. Getter cancellation keeps the editor open.
double_click: Viewport output carries an unambiguous geometry hit for a primary double click outside the title strip. The application opens only visible, selectable block roots when no modeling/getter/region session owns input. Ambiguous hits retain the existing chooser and title double clicks retain maximization.
scene_policy: Source previews retain ordinary visibility and locked styling while overlaying only picked source highlights. Ordinary picking excludes protected/released edit records.
native_limits: One fresh line instance, real owned viewport double click, exposed-member/root-state check and discard/model-ID restoration. Native Add Object viewport groups, ambiguity, point snapping/filter/CPlane semantics, selection/history and pixel equivalence are not newly qualified; prior control captures constrain closed-model edits.
performance_scope: Cached original source eligibility avoids repeated object-table searches during viewport picking. No native performance or GPU measurement was made.
remaining_scope: Linked definitions and persistence of open editors
Broader native picking, group expansion, snapping and history qualification
